study_identification_part.si_4_title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Dataset II: Human Connectome Project; Dataset III: REST-meta-MDD Project; Dataset I: two local hospitals (discovery cohort and external test set).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "In dataset I, we enrolled 127 depressed patients and 110 healthy control (HC) participants from the Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University as the discovery cohort. Additionally, 60 patients and 56 HC participants from Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital were recruited as an external test set..."; "To construct the normative models, we downloaded phenotypic data and MRI T1-weighted data from the Human Connectome Project (dataset II; 510 HC participants; age range, 22-36 years) (28) and REST-meta-MDD Project (dataset III; 229 HC participants; age range, 18-65 years; site 20) (29)."
